original.statement: lambda-promtail no longer panics when the DROP_LABELS environment variable is empty.

corrected.statement: lambda-promtail no longer panics when the DROP_LABELS environment variable is empty; exposed environments are those running lambda-promtail with DROP_LABELS set to an empty value.

decision.reason: [ev-4f0f13cefd09] says only that lambda-promtail panicked when the DROP_LABELS env var was empty. The proposed exposure, DROP_LABELS "set", is too broad because it would also flag environments with a non-empty DROP_LABELS value, and the evidence does not say those were affected. The exposure should be DROP_LABELS equal to the empty string. Unlike P1, the value should be a true empty string, not literal quote characters. The evidence does not say whether an unset variable also triggered the panic, so confidence is low.
